name: @dcp-ai/wasm
description: WebAssembly module for DCP-AI v2.0 — post-quantum crypto, composite signatures, and full verification in the browser

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../rust && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../wasm/pkg -- --features wasm && rm -f ../wasm/pkg/.gitignore
scripts.build:wasm:node: cd ../rust && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir ../wasm/pkg -- --features wasm && rm -f ../wasm/pkg/.gitignore
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
scripts.test: npm run build:ts && node test/verify-vectors.mjs && node test/build-sign.mjs && node test/experimental-candidate-ingress.mjs && node test/experimental-candidate-router.mjs && node test/v1-verify.mjs && node test/experimental-candidate-verify.mjs && node test/packlist.mjs
